commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
She goes on, answering her friend.

That day my kohl-lined eyes fixed in me an endless sickness that I can’t escape. Now their water has dried up and they can’t even weep. They fixed it there by showing me one who would leave and not return. They did me harm first, and harm has come to them.
